biggest_catch: No current campaign exists to join: the official earn page is geo-blocked for US users ('Learn and Earn isn't available in your country') and every officially documented campaign (Sandbox, REVV, PPAY, BAND) is years old and closed.
catches: Loading https://coinmarketcap.com/earn/ live returns 'Learn and Earn isn't available in your country' — the program is not accessible from the US.
No current official campaign with a reward pool, dates, or entry page could be found anywhere on coinmarketcap.com.
All documented CMC Earn campaigns (Sandbox ~$400k SAND pool, REVV $5, PPAY $5, BAND $10) ran in 2020-2021 and are long closed.
Historically CMC Earn campaigns required a KYC-verified Binance account and were first-come-first-served, so even when campaigns ran, spots vanished fast.
